description: Hy-Vee, Inc. is an American retail company that operates a chain of supermarkets and convenience stores. The company offers grocery shopping, online ordering, and delivery services, and provides additional retail functions such as bakeries, delicatessens, florist departments, pharmacies, wine and spirits, health clinics, fitness centers, and full-service restaurants. Hy-Vee also manages fuel stations with convenience stores, car washes, and offers food service options including salad bars and drive-in theatres. The company serves individual customers and businesses across multiple states in the Midwest and Southern United States.
core_offerings: Fitness Center and Drive-In Theatre Retail
Car Wash and Convenience Store Retail

description: PÉPITES SAS, known as Yumi, is a French company engaged in the production and distribution of natural, organic ginger shots and maxishots, as well as other beverage products. The company operates both as a beverage distributor and a soft drinks shop, offering its products through e-commerce and retail channels. Yumi emphasizes sustainability by sourcing ginger from Peru, where it is cultivated organically, and uses cold pressing and high-pressure processing techniques in its production processes.

description: Coles Supermarkets Australia Pty Ltd is an Australian retail company that operates a network of supermarkets and convenience stores, offering a broad range of grocery and household products. The company also provides financial services, including personal loans, credit cards, and insurance products, and manages a supply chain for its retail operations. Coles is involved in store development, retail marketing, buying, and customer insights, and integrates technology and information technology to support its retail activities. The company is certified for sustainability and ethical sourcing.

DECATHLON ITALIA S.r.l. Unipersonale is an Italian private company engaged in the retail and distribution of sports equipment and apparel. The company operates both physical and online stores, and provides additional services such as equipment rental, repair, maintenance, and second-hand equipment sales. Decathlon also manages production, design, IT, logistics, and administrative functions, and is certified in quality and environmental management. The company incorporates sustainability practices, including circular economy initiatives and eco-design, and is committed to reducing environmental impact.
core_offerings: Sustainable Sourcing and Supply Chain Solutions

description: Walmart Stores, Inc. is an American retail corporation engaged in the operation of hypermarkets, discount department stores, grocery stores, and online retail platforms. The company offers a broad range of consumer goods, including groceries, home goods, electronics, health and wellness products, automotive supplies, pet supplies, and school and office supplies. Walmart also provides business retail services, such as Walmart Business, and operates Sam's Club retail warehouses. The company is involved in logistics, transportation, and information technology, and is certified for sustainability initiatives.

Aotea New Zealand Online Limited, known as Aotea Wellness, is a New Zealand company engaged in the retail and distribution of natural wellness products, including skincare, immune support supplements, and natural toothpaste. The company operates both physical and online stores, serving individual customers and businesses. In addition to its core retail and distribution activities, Aotea Wellness is involved in community initiatives and sponsorships. The company is part of a larger network of stores and brands, including Aotea Gifts, Kapeka, and Hellokiwi, which collectively offer a range of health, beauty, fashion, and destination products.

F21 IPCO, LLC, known as Forever 21, is an American retail company engaged in fast-fashion apparel and accessories for women, men, plus-size, and children. The company operates a direct-to-consumer business model, offering a broad range of fashion products, including clothing, shoes, accessories, and beauty items, through both physical outlets and an online platform. Forever 21 serves a diverse customer base and is part of the apparel industry.

M.H. Alshaya Co. W.L.L., known as H&M Home, is a Kuwaiti company engaged in the design, production, and retail of home goods, including clothing, home decor, beauty products, and home furniture. The company operates primarily in the UAE, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia, serving a diverse customer base that includes women, men, children, and families. H&M Home also manages an online shopping platform and is part of the H&M Group, which is committed to sustainability and social responsibility.

PEZ Candy, Inc., DBA PEZ Candy, is an American company specialized in the production and distribution of PEZ dispensers and candies. The company operates as both a manufacturer and retailer, serving a global market with products distributed through retail channels, online stores, and partnerships with retailers and distributors. PEZ Candy also engages in the distribution of gift sets, party favors, and related merchandise. The company is committed to sustainability and ethical practices, with a focus on reducing waste and promoting eco-friendly packaging.

Lululemon Athletica Inc. is a Canadian multinational company engaged in the retail of technical apparel, athletic shoes, loungewear, and related lifestyle products. The company operates both physical stores and an online platform, serving a global market with a focus on performance apparel and footwear. Lululemon also offers accessories and personal care products, and is committed to sustainability and ethical practices.

Its offerings include payment processing platforms, kiosk systems, and related IT infrastructure for businesses.

description: Aircash d.o.o. is a Croatian financial institution and software company that operates as an electronic money institution and payment provider. The company offers digital wallet and prepaid card services, as well as a marketplace for parking, transport, entertainment, utilities, and telecoms. Aircash also provides payment solutions for online accounts, bus and ferry tickets, parking, tolls, gift cards, and utility bills. The company is licensed by the Croatian National Bank and the Swiss Self-Regulatory Organization, and serves clients across multiple European countries.

description: ITGC-Infotech Global Consultancy Private Limited, known as European Pay, is a French fintech company that develops and operates a digital payment platform utilizing QR technology for contactless transactions. The company provides digital payment solutions, including mobile recharges, bill payments, and online shopping, as well as a digital wallet service. European Pay serves small and medium-sized enterprises, street vendors, and local vendors, and collaborates with banks to deliver financial services. The company is a member of the DPS TradeMark and DPS SAS and incorporates eco-friendly practices by eliminating paper receipts.

METRO Cash & Carry Romania SRL, known as METRO România, is a Romanian wholesale company that operates in the hospitality, restaurant, and catering sector, as well as serving independent retailers. The company supplies food and non-food products, including fresh and frozen produce, meat, dairy, beverages, and professional equipment and furniture. METRO România also provides digital services for retail operations and manages a central logistics platform for distribution and supply chain management. The company is involved in sustainability initiatives and is certified as a Top Employer in Romania and Europe.
core_offerings: Proprietary Brand Product Development and Distribution

description: L'Essinganaise is a French company specialized in the manufacturing and online sale of prepared and cooked African dishes, including traditional African cuisine, soups, and beverages. The company operates as both a food manufacturer and a service provider in the food industry, focusing on authentic African cuisine. L'Essinganaise serves customers across France and emphasizes traditional African recipes prepared with exotic and ethnic spices sourced directly from Africa, using organic ingredients and aseptic processing.

AriZona Beverages USA, LLC., known as DrinkAriZona, is an American beverage company engaged in the production and distribution of iced tea, juice cocktails, fruit snacks, energy drinks, and related merchandise. The company operates both as a beverage manufacturer and distributor, serving convenience store shoppers, individual consumers, and families in the United States and internationally through its European subsidiary. DrinkAriZona also offers subscription services and an online store for its product range.

description: Brink's Solutions Nederland B.V., DBA Brink's Solutions Nederland, is a Dutch company that provides payment and cash management solutions for entrepreneurs and businesses, with a focus on the retail and financial services sectors. The company operates a network of cash depositing centers, offers cash depositing, cash management, and cash transport services, and manages cash depositing for retail locations. It also operates an Innovation Centre that delivers workshops and training related to cash management. Brink's Solutions Nederland is ISO certified and serves clients in the Netherlands and internationally.

description: Kohler New Zealand Limited is a New Zealand company engaged in the manufacturing and retail of plumbing products and cabinetry. The company operates as a bathroom supply store and general store, offering a range of products such as baths, toilets, tapware, basins, furniture, and accessories for both residential and commercial markets. Kohler also provides technical support and warranty services, and is part of the Kohler Kitchen and Bath Group, which includes a portfolio of brands and products.

description: Renault Commercial Roumanie S.R.L., DBA Dacia, is a Romanian automotive company engaged in the production and distribution of passenger and commercial vehicles. The company operates as a manufacturer and distributor, offering a range of vehicles and providing services such as vehicle financing, trade-in options, and maintenance contracts. Dacia also offers electric and mild hybrid vehicles, participates in government programs for environmentally friendly vehicles, and maintains a network of authorized dealers and an online platform for vehicle sales. The company is part of the Renault Commercial Group and is associated with Renault.
